title: A Shark Older Than Countries
hook: Greenland sharks swimming today were born before America existed.
payoff: The oldest dated shark, born between 1504 and 1744, lived during the Ming Dynasty, making it the longest-lived vertebrate of its time.

scenes.voiceover: Greenland sharks swimming today were born before America existed.
Deep inside her eye sits a protein older than our country.
How could tissue made inside an embryo survive for around 400 years?
The Greenland shark grows only about a centimeter each year.
Massive concentrations of urea protect her proteins from denaturation.
Centuries later, scientists radiocarbon-dated that untouched core to unlock her history.
That single molecule proved the longest-lived vertebrate was born during the Ming Dynasty.
The oldest dated shark, born between 1504 and 1744, lived during the Ming Dynasty, making it the longest-lived vertebrate of its time.
